main_subject.description: The same adult East Asian woman with shoulder-length dark-brown hair, soft natural makeup, and a gentle contemplative expression across four frames.
main_subject.wardrobe: A bright red cable-knit beanie, matching chunky red wool scarf, and plain black wool coat.
main_subject.continuity: Keep adult identity, wardrobe, snow detail, and high-key white winter setting consistent in every panel.

grid_sequence: Close portrait smiling softly while holding scarf near chin.
Side-profile portrait looking upward at light snowfall.
Portrait beneath a plain red umbrella with one hand adjusting the scarf.
Three-quarter portrait with a small warm smile.
composition_elements.setting: Minimal seamless white winter studio with real-looking snowflakes; no printed backdrop marks.
composition_elements.layout: Four equal panels, thin white gutters, no captions or text.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Soft high-key studio light with gentle facial modeling and natural snowy highlights.

technical_specs.rendering: Visible pores, realistic snow on knit fibers, natural hands, crisp eyes, no retouch-heavy effect.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a square 2 by 2 winter-fashion contact sheet of the same adult East Asian woman with shoulder-length dark-brown hair, soft natural makeup, and a gentle contemplative expression. In every frame she wears a bright red cable-knit beanie, matching chunky red wool scarf, and plain black wool coat. Show four equal panels: close portrait holding scarf near chin; side profile looking upward at snow; portrait under a plain red umbrella adjusting scarf; and a three-quarter warm smile. Use a minimal seamless white winter studio with realistic falling snow, thin white gutters, no captions, soft high-key 85mm lighting, visible pores, realistic snow on knit fibers, crisp eyes, natural hands, and no heavy retouching. No readable text, logo, watermark, or childlike styling.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, readable text, logo, watermark, plastic skin, distorted hands, extra fingers, AI artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Optional identity references must depict a consenting adult. Wardrobe, umbrella, and snowy studio references are replaceable and cannot introduce text or brand marks.
